entities.name: Desert of Bones
entities.description: A dune desert with a caravan road stretching to the capital of Ki'pamu, once part of Zhalfir.

entities.name: Ki'pamu
entities.description: A capital city reached by a caravan road across the Desert of Bones.

entities.name: Kotara
entities.description: An angel summoned by Sabul Hajeen who flew over the Desert of Bones.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: The plane that now contains the Desert of Bones.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who phased out Zhalfir to spare it from the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: The person who destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The invasion Teferi wanted to spare Zhalfir from.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The later invasion after which the desert returned to the multiverse.

events.summary: Summoned by Sabul Hajeen, Kotara flew over the Desert of Bones and noted a caravan with Viashino guides.
events.quote: When the angel Kotara was summoned by Sabul Hajeen

events.summary: Teferi phased Zhalfir, including the Desert of Bones, out of Dominaria to spare it from the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: the planeswalker Teferi wanted to spare it from the horrors of the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria

events.summary: Jeska destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void, forever losing the phased lands from Dominaria.
events.quote: when Jeska destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void

events.summary: The desert returned to the multiverse in the New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch after the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The desert was returned to the multiverse during the New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch

relations.note: It now exists as part of Zhalfir.
relations.quote: It now exists as part of the plane of Zhalfir
